title: Get User Pages
description:
Get a user's visited pages.
The User Pages file contains a series of all the pages that the user has visited, including the raw event data recorded on each page.
### Additional Information * [Using Download User Pages and Download User Events](https://help.fullstory.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020624454)

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: The application-specific ID you've given to the user. You will have passed that ID through the [FS.identify](/browser/identification/identify-users/) Browser API function.
